# Minion DPS engine

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** minion, dps-engine

## Derived / confirmed formula

Minion hit = shared_base(level) x coefficient x (1+minion increased) x minion additional product x crit x double x minion enemy-mitigation x rate; scaled ONLY by minion_* pools + a shared per-level Base Damage table (player pools never leak).

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Foundation shipped; unverified in-game. Validate a modelled minion's DPS vs the Recount.

## Implementation (engine model)

engine/minion_offense.py::calculate_minion_offense builds a full OffenseResult from minion-scoped pools only (minion_* stats filtered by the 'minion' tag), shared_base + own crit base (500 CSR / 150%) from data/seasons/<S>/_minion_base_stats.json. A minion deals damage ONLY through a registered bespoke module (MINION_MODULES); unmodelled owners resolve NYI. compute.py runs a minion pass after the player pass. Minion mitigation uses the MINION's penetration, not the player's.
